beats.summary: Tesfaye begins his palace duties before dawn, carefully preparing golden honey wine with steady, practiced hands in devoted anonymity.
beats.picture: Centered medium shot of Tesfaye, a young Ethiopian server in a crisp white cotton tunic, holding a glass berele flask filled with glowing golden honey wine in a warm, lamp-lit palace room.

beats.summary: At the evening banquet, an arrogant nobleman belittles Tesfaye by asking aloud if the emperor even knows his name, forcing the server to lower his eyes.
beats.picture: Centered medium shot of an older Ethiopian banquet guest in a dark formal cape over white linen, casting a sharp, dismissive smirk beside candlelit glasses on a banquet table.

beats.summary: The great emperor learns Tesfaye's name and raises a toast to him from the head of the table, moving the server to hold back tears of overwhelming validation.
beats.feeling: Profound recognition and tender emotional release.
beats.picture: Centered close-up of Tesfaye in his white tunic, his eyes glistening with restrained tears of quiet gratitude in the warm banquet candlelight.

beats.summary: Alone in a palace doorway after the banquet, Tesfaye pours the last measure of honey wine and takes a quiet sip under the night sky, transformed by having been seen.
beats.picture: Centered full-body silhouette of Tesfaye standing in a stone palace archway at night, raising a small glass flask against the soft golden glow of distant palace lights.
